purpose: Versioned, machine-verifiable evaluation-views contract for the formal benchmark. Fixes which Gold view feeds which metric family, forbids cross-view mixing, and separates modality-label metrics from six-field span metrics.

coarse_sentence_level.role: primary (Sun-aligned main view) -- PUBLICATION GATED on consistency proof

transform.name: formal_sentence_level_coarse_view
transform.rule: one synthetic clause per sentence over [0, len(approved_text_en)); per field one span [min(start), max(end)) over all annotated spans in the sentence; absent fields stay absent; text = approved_text_en slice; modality label = first non-empty clause modality string; modality evidence = merged clause spans (published Gold does not carry local modality evidence spans)
transform.normalized: spans carry normalized = ' '.join(text.casefold().split()) for non-modality fields (deterministic derivation, not copied from any development file)
transform.consistency_proof_required: derived view must hash- and record-level match the historical sentence-level coarse gold (2026-08-07 user-confirmed main view); otherwise primary formal metrics MUST NOT be published and the exact diff must be reported

consistency_status_2026_08_10.reason: published formal Gold stores modality as a plain string; the local modality evidence spans of the historical coarse gold (Layer E modality.span) are not reproducible from it. All other fields are identical.
consistency_status_2026_08_10.consequence: historical coarse numbers remain development-side provenance; the formal coarse MAIN-view metrics are NOT published. Fine-grained six-field span metrics and modality-label metrics remain computable from the published Gold.

fine_gold.note: fine-grained formal Gold remains the second/对照 view; never mixed with the coarse view in the same table

rules.modality_evidence_span_metrics: unavailable from the published formal Gold (modality published as plain string; Layer E local evidence spans are adjudication content not carried by the decision-only Gold); reported as unavailable with reason, never silently zero

claim_scopes.formal: only the B0 formal arm (sun_rule_only) may carry claim_scope=formal; D1/H1 remain candidate / formal-gate-blocked
claim_scopes.candidate: D1/H1 zero-API re-evaluations are candidates, never formal

authorization.decision: formal main report = sentence-level coarse five span-bearing fields (actor/action/condition/constraint/exception) + separate four-class modality-label metrics; modality evidence-span metrics explicitly unavailable (never zeroed, never aggregated); fine-grained five fields diagnostic/对照; historical six-field coarse aggregate stays development provenance only
